feeSource.title: Portal reported no fees
feeSource.what: This booking arrived from the portal without a fee breakdown. The statement therefore charges no cleaning, utility or pet fee: what the portal did not report, the guest did not pay. The guest price is consequently lower than the amount stored for this property.
feeSource.channexImport: The booking was fetched retroactively when the channel was connected. According to the portal intermediary, such bookings contain no extras and no cleaning fees — this cannot be retrieved later. If the fee is to be billed, add it as a line item on the booking.
feeSource.portalReportsNone: The portal does not list the fee as a separate line item on this booking. With Booking.com this depends on the property configuration (Property → Policies → Additional fees) and on the date from which the fee applies there: a fee introduced later is rightly missing on older bookings.
feeSource.noPayload: There is no portal message for this booking (import of existing data). Without it, there is no way to determine which fees the guest paid.

expenses.intro: Amounts paid out to the owner on top, or charged back to them. They count in full towards the payout — no commission is deducted.
expenses.toOwnerHint: They receive an additional payment, e.g. damage compensation.
expenses.fromOwnerHint: Deducted from their payout, e.g. materials and labour.
expenses.saveFirst: Offset items belong to a saved statement. Save the statement first, then you can record items here.

info.totalPayout: What reaches the business after the portal fees have been deducted. The owner's and the management's share are derived from this amount.
info.ownerPayout: The share paid out to the owner: total payout less commission, plus the offset items.
info.pmPayout: The share that stays with the business — the commission on the rental. Offset items are not included here.

expenses.title: In favour and charged
expenses.direction: “In favour of the owner” increases their payout, for example a reimbursement. “Charged to the owner” reduces it, for example materials or the business's labour time.
expenses.noCommission: These amounts count in full towards the payout — no commission is charged on them.

dash.title: What the dash means
dash.meaning: A dash means “not recorded” — not “zero”. The value cannot be calculated because a detail is missing.
dash.whereToFix: If the commission rate is missing, enter it in the owner's master data or as a differing rate on the individual property.
dash.aria: Explanation of the dash instead of an amount
dash.inline: A dash stands for a missing value, not for 0.00.

info.deductPercentage: The commission rate this statement calculates with. Empty means: the rate from the owner's master data applies, or the differing rate set on the individual property.

status.title: The three states of a statement
status.draft: Draft: still editable. Amounts are recalculated on every change.
status.finalized: Finalized: invoice number assigned, totals frozen. Changes are no longer possible.
status.cancelled: Cancelled: reversed by a cancellation invoice. The original invoice remains on record as a document.

finalize.title: Finalize statement
finalize.what: On finalizing, the invoice number is assigned and all totals are frozen as a document of record.
finalize.irreversible: This cannot be undone. A finalized invoice can only be reversed by a cancellation invoice.

info.basis: Determines when a booking falls within the period: with Check-in by the arrival day, with Check-out by the departure day. A booking spanning the turn of the month lands in one month or the other depending on your choice.
info.statuses: Only bookings with one of the selected statuses are settled. The default is confirmed and completed bookings — cancelled ones normally do not belong in a payout.

view_guest_contact.label: Show guest contact details
view_guest_contact.hint: Allow access to guest details. Required for inbox access.

edit_guest.label: Edit guest card
edit_guest.hint: Allow creating guests, changing master data and maintaining addresses/contacts/IDs/notes/consents. Without this permission the guest card is read-only.

view_booking_source.label: Show booking source
view_booking_source.hint: Allow seeing where the booking came from, e.g. Airbnb, Booking.com.

sync_ical.label: Sync calendar via iCal
sync_ical.hint: Grant access to the settings in order to sync the calendar via iCal.

download_booking_report.label: Download booking report
download_booking_report.hint: Allow downloading the property's booking report.

access_homepage_builder.label: Access the website builder
access_homepage_builder.hint: Grants access to the website tools, except the publishing permission. Limited access to dashboard, bookings, calendar and owner payment access.

hide_prices.label: Remove booking prices and quote details
hide_prices.hint: Removes price and quote details in bookings and the calendar.

manage_closed_periods.label: Manage closed periods only
manage_closed_periods.hint: Grants access only to managing closed periods. When selected, the permissions to show guest contact details, guest name, edit calendar and bookings, show booking source and download the booking report are disabled.

access_pm_features.label: Access PM module features
access_pm_features.hint: Allows access to the PM modules from the main menu. To grant access to specific PM module features, assign the corresponding permissions.

owner_reporting.label: Access reporting for owners
owner_reporting.hint: Provides access to financial reports for property owners.

manage_partners.label: Manage travel agencies & partners
manage_partners.hint: Allows managing the travel agency records: master data, contacts, contracts and agreed rates of travel agencies and tour operators.

pm_manage_booking_images.label: Add and delete booking images
pm_manage_booking_images.hint: Allows uploading and removing images linked to bookings.

pm_manage_property_images.label: Add and delete property images
pm_manage_property_images.hint: Allows adding or deleting images of the properties.

pm_checkout_alerts.label: See alerts when guests check out
pm_checkout_alerts.hint: Notifies the user when a guest has checked out and left the property.

pm_deposit_alerts.label: Receive an alert when a deposit is missing
pm_deposit_alerts.hint: Shows alerts for bookings where a deposit is missing.

pm_payment_alerts.label: See alerts when a payment is missing
pm_payment_alerts.hint: Notifies the user about unpaid bookings.

pm_chat.label: Access the chat in the PM module app
pm_chat.hint: Allows the user to communicate via the chat function in the PM module app.

pm_edit_comments.label: Edit and delete booking comments
pm_edit_comments.hint: Grants permission to change or remove booking comments.

pm_edit_checkin_times.label: Edit check-in and check-out times
pm_edit_checkin_times.hint: Allows changing the guest's arrival and departure times.

pm_guest_module.label: Access the guest module
pm_guest_module.hint: Grants permission to access the guest module.

pm_guest_portal_settings.label: Edit the guest portal settings
pm_guest_portal_settings.hint: Grants permission to configure the guest portal.

pm_revenue_charts.label: Show revenue-related charts
pm_revenue_charts.hint: Grants access to charts that show the financial performance.

pm_nonrevenue_charts.label: Show non-revenue-related charts
pm_nonrevenue_charts.hint: Allows viewing analytics on operations and occupancy.

pm_property_area.label: Access the property area
pm_property_area.hint: Grants permission to view the properties.

pm_guest_details.label: Show guest details
pm_guest_details.hint: Allows access to the guest's contact details.

pm_booking_total.label: See the booking total
pm_booking_total.hint: Shows the breakdown of the total cost of bookings.

pm_owner_email.label: See the property owner's email address
pm_owner_email.hint: Provides access to the property owner's email address.

pm_share_alerts.label: Share alerts
pm_share_alerts.hint: Allows notifying others about system alerts.

pm_share_images.label: Share images in the mobile app
pm_share_images.hint: Allows sharing photos via the mobile app.

pm_view_add_comments.label: Show and add booking comments
pm_view_add_comments.hint: Allows users to see and leave comments on bookings.

pm_view_notes.label: Show booking notes
pm_view_notes.hint: Allows viewing notes added to bookings.

pm_view_booking_images.label: See booking images
pm_view_booking_images.hint: Grants access to photos linked to bookings.

pm_detailed_payments.label: See detailed payment information
pm_detailed_payments.hint: Provides a detailed breakdown of the booking payments.

pm_owner_details.label: See property owner details
pm_owner_details.hint: Allows viewing details about the property owner.

pm_view_property_images.label: View property images
pm_view_property_images.hint: Allows access to photos of the properties.

pm_website_access.label: Open the PM module website
pm_website_access.hint: Grants access to the PM module website. When disabled, users can only access the mobile app.

inbox_view_all.label: See all conversations
inbox_view_all.hint: Sees all inbox conversations of the account. Without this permission the user only sees the conversations assigned to them. Requires inbox access (chat).

inbox_reply.label: Reply to guests
inbox_reply.hint: Allows sending outgoing messages to guests. Without this permission the inbox is read-only.

inbox_assign.label: Assign conversations
inbox_assign.hint: Allows assigning conversations to team members or changing the assignment.

inbox_manage_config.label: Configure the inbox
inbox_manage_config.hint: Allows managing message templates, automations and AI settings.
